Update a QWAdata object to match a QWAimages object

Source: R/partial_update.R
update_QWAdata.Rd

Synchronises x with the images in meta:

  • images in meta but not in x are read and added,

  • images in x but not in meta are removed,

  • images in imgs_to_reread are read again from their raw data files and replace the existing data (e.g. after re-analysis in ROXAS/ROXAS AI).

Usage

update_QWAdata(
  x,
  meta,
  imgs_to_reread = NULL,
  exclude_mode = NULL,
  reset_manual_flags = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

a QWAdata object

meta

a QWAimages object; defines the images in the updated data

imgs_to_reread

optional character vector of image_label values whose raw data files are read again; must be a subset of meta$image_label. NULL (default) re-reads none.

exclude_mode

Deprecated, see complete_flags().

reset_manual_flags

Logical; only applies to imgs_to_reread. If TRUE (default), any manual edits made via the flags Shiny app are reset. If FALSE (i.e. assuming the dating was not affected by the re-analysis), the columns set in the flags app (colType "qc_input") are kept, and so is exclude_issues where it differs from the value derived from the old automatic flags.

Value

An updated QWAdata object

Details

For all read images, derived cell/ring measures and flag columns that are already present in x are recalculated. Duplicate-ring flags (duplicate_ring, exclude_dupl) are recalculated for all woodpiece-years that contain an added, removed or re-read image, since overlaps may change; any manual duplicate selection in these woodpiece-years is replaced.

Added and re-read images are treated as new data: their flags need to be inspected again, e.g. in the flags Shiny app or by re-applying any custom rule for exclude_issues. Only if a re-analysis was minor and did not change the dating, use reset_manual_flags = FALSE to keep the previous manual flags.
